name: three-employees-queried-and-emailed-as-csv
description: The README/IT request names three employees; each is looked up by first and last name, the results are aggregated in request order and written as CSV with a header row and ISO dates (2-digit years stored by MySQL as 20xx). The CSV is the HTTP response, the email's text body and the 'employees.csv' text/plain attachment. Line separators are matched as \r?\n because only line contents are documented.

source.reference: querying-a-db-and-attaching-results-to-an-email/src/test/java/org/mule/examples/QueryingDbAndAttachingResultsToAnEmailIT.java#attachmentsTest (request src/test/resources/message.xml, DB rows from MySQLDbCreator, asserts the email text part contains 'Chava,Puckett,F,1985-09-02,2008-10-12' and 'Mona,Sosa,M,1950-09-26,2007-11-27'); header row/columns from src/main/app/attachments.xml dw 'Map Collection to CSV' (header=true); set-attachment attachmentName="employees.csv" contentType="text/plain"; object-to-string mimeType="text/csv"
